tasks.title: Document live CLI build prerequisites
tasks.summary: Make the live-test documentation explicit that cross-crate CLI live tests execute target/debug/covenant and therefore require cargo build -p covenant before targeted live runs.
expectedFailureModes: A targeted live CLI test uses a stale target/debug/covenant binary.
Operators run the documented command and get a misleading unknown-command failure.
The full quick gate passes while an isolated live CLI command fails because the binary prerequisite is implicit.
tasks.nextAction: Document the cargo build -p covenant prerequisite for targeted live CLI tests and update public live coverage docs.

tasks.title: Define capability scope schemas
tasks.summary: Specify stable scope payload shapes for each capability action namespace before enforcing more granular signed permissions in code.
expectedFailureModes: Capability scopes remain arbitrary JSON with no compatibility contract.
Future code enforcement rejects existing grants because no schema migration path exists.
Public docs imply scoped permissions are stronger than the current implementation can prove.
tasks.nextAction: Write the capability scope schema contract and mark any enforcement gaps explicitly.

tasks.title: Define audit root signing policy
tasks.summary: Record the first public policy for signing audit roots and publishing verifiable provenance without overclaiming immutable transparency.
expectedFailureModes: Audit integrity remains local-only while docs imply public verifiability.
Signing identity, key rotation, and root subject formats are left ambiguous.
Release artifacts cannot tie audit roots to task and commit provenance.
tasks.nextAction: Add an architecture decision record for audit root signing and update status/docs to match.

tasks.title: Document repeatable Linux gVisor runner setup
tasks.summary: Document the repeatable Linux host prerequisites for the opt-in runsc/rootfs live sandbox test before making stronger sandbox claims.
expectedFailureModes: The gVisor live test exists but cannot be reproduced by contributors.
Sandbox status claims outpace the tested Linux environment.
Rootfs, runsc, and environment variable prerequisites are scattered across test code.
tasks.nextAction: Write the repeatable Linux gVisor live-test runner guide and link it from runtime sandbox docs.
